concept: Distinguishing a strong argument from a persuasive one — logic vs. rhetoric
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student evaluates two arguments on the same topic — one logically strong but flat, one persuasive but weak — and picks which is more convincing vs. which is more correct
exercise.branching_choice: Student explains their reasoning for each pick
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the persuasive one feel convincing despite its weaker logic

assessment.success_marker: student can name at least one specific reason the persuasive argument felt convincing that wasn't about its logic
